text_block_list.text:
When I arrived at the Trainer's office in the morning,
a single sheet of paper was resting on the desk...

"Waiting in the gymnasium!
　　　　　　　　　　　　—From the Class Rep!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for you, Trainer-san.
...Are you prepared?

Could it be there was something she couldn't stomach?
Slightly shaken, as I braced myself—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You have demonstrated exceptional leadership
and continue to polish my talents!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes! Thanks to that, my Bakushin has been polished even further lately!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And with that,
I express my utmost BAKUSHIN enthusiasm!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I may be the honor student among honor students,
but you are truly the Trainer among Trainers!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"This is a letter expressing my respect to you...
Or rather, a certificate of commendation! Please accept it!"

A heartwarming letter from a girl who's normally completely wild—
...Reading the certificate of commendation, I felt a slight tear welling up in my eye.
